overview.description: The Google DeepMind AI Lab Ecosystem ETF (DEPW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund provides exposure to US and non-US companies with direct links to the Google DeepMind artificial intelligence ecosystem. It is an actively managed fund that utilizes a proprietary model-driven thematic scoring process to select investments. DEPW was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.
